{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]  # Exclude QC-failure rows

df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')  # Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient

df_treatment = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

fraction_responded = df_treatment['responded'].mean()

fraction_responded"}
